messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- INC-2025-004 was an incident affecting the notifier on 2025-02-06. [valid 2025-02-11 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-004]
- The root cause of INC-2025-004 was a consumer offset stuck after a broker restart. [valid 2025-02-11 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-004]
- On 2025-09-08, Team Boreal observed that the notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout and pinged the owners. [valid 2025-09-08 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-08-2]
- On 2025-04-26, the ledger saw write latency spike tenfold for an hour during INC-2025-011. [valid 2025-04-28 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-011]
- On 2026-01-13, Team Atlas noticed that the ledger's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-01-13 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-01-13]
- INC-2025-023 was an incident affecting the indexer on 2025-10-13. [valid 2025-10-16 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- INC-2025-017 was caused by an expired intermediate certificate. [valid 2025-08-01 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- As of 2025-09-15, the reporting service no longer depends on the ledger; it reads from the event bus instead. [valid 2025-09-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-15]
    earlier: The reporting service depends on the ledger. [valid 2025-04-08 to 2025-09-15; recorded by standup/dune/2025-04-08]
- On 2025-09-15, Team Dune decided that the reporting service will read from the event bus instead of querying the ledger directly because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs. [decision; valid 2025-09-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-15]
- INC-2025-011 was caused by an index missing after the schema migration. [valid 2025-04-28 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-011]
- On 2026-01-05, Team Cinder observed that the ledger's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change. [valid 2026-01-05 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-01-05]
- Team Boreal kept the notifier until 2025-04-04. [valid 2025-04-04 to now; recorded by handover/2025-04-04-notifier]
- INC-2025-017 was an incident affecting the auth gateway on 2025-07-27. [valid 2025-08-01 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- On 2026-01-01, Team Cinder noticed that the indexer's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-01-01 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-01-01]
- On 2025-03-17, Tomasz Nowak wrote the handover document for the billing service handover for Marcus. [valid 2025-03-17 to now; recorded by handover/2025-03-17-billing-api]
- On 2025-07-28, Team Cinder observed that the ledger's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy. [valid 2025-07-28 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-07-28-2]
- As of 2025-11-13, the ledger lives with the Ember team; Team Atlas kept it until then. [valid 2025-11-13 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-13-ledger]
    earlier: The ledger lives with Team Atlas. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-11-13; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08]
- On 2025-11-07, Farah walked Marcus through the reporting service runbook. [valid 2025-11-07 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-07-reporting]
- A silent reindex failure left stale results for two days in INC-2025-023. [valid 2025-10-16 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- The billing service depends on the ledger for invoice postings. [valid 2025-03-10 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-03-10]

Question: Which note corrected the recorded owner of reporting, and when?
